title: MH HSC Class 12 Maths
summary: Maharashtra HSC Class 12 Mathematics & Statistics board questions, 2015 to 2026, five a day. Questions the board asked again come first, highest count first, then the question types it keeps asking, then every other question.
note: Repeats were found by comparing every question with every other and reading each candidate group. Papers before 2024 come from a chapterwise compilation and are incomplete, so counts for those years are a minimum.
